subject: Weekend schedule note
text:
Hi there,
For Saturday I plan to sleep in, then handle invoices and one small website update. After that I want to walk the park loop and read for an hour. If the request meant moving the client file earlier, tell me before evening because I can do it Sunday instead. I did not include the new folder you mentioned; I was not sure which instructions to follow. Otherwise, I will send the summary Monday morning. I can also review the draft later, but only if the feedback comes before I start the next task.
